category_title: Struggling and reluctant middle school learners in intervention language arts
scenario_title: Responding to daily questions on class blog
minimal_context: The student is using a computer during a rotation to respond to a daily question about the novel 'Stargirl' on the class blog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into the computers and respond to today's question about the characters' actions in 'Stargirl' on the class blog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just wrote that I agree with Maria. She did a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you write a little more about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why? I gave a specific answer to the specific question. Is this going to be on the standardized test?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to add another sentence to your blog post.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers to a peer and pushes the keyboard away) I'm refusing to work on this anymore. I already wrote my two sentences and I don't care about developing my writing skills if it's not for a test score.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please log into the computers and respond to today's question about the characters' actions in 'Stargirl' on the class blog.

STUDENT: I just wrote that I agree with Maria. She did a good thing.

TUTOR: Can you write a little more about that?

STUDENT: Why? I gave a specific answer to the specific question. Is this going to be on the standardized test?

TUTOR: Just try to add another sentence to your blog post.

STUDENT: (Whispers to a peer and pushes the keyboard away) I'm refusing to work on this anymore. I already wrote my two sentences and I don't care about developing my writing skills if it's not for a test score.

task.content: Responding to teacher-posted questions about the novel 'Stargirl' on the class blog

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: In the beginning, the students briefly answered the daily questions.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: rarely elaborated beyond a specific answer to a specific question
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: viewed reading and writing specifically as skills necessary for performance on standardized tests

behavior_patterns.condition: When responding to peers on the blog
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: wrote that they agreed with each other and gave one to two sentences explaining what they thought
behavior_patterns.internal_state: attitudes of indifference toward test scores
